evals.name: complete_removal
evals.prompt: Replace old_parser with new_parser. Remove the old interface completely. Backward compatibility is not required.
expect: Removes the old implementation and obsolete callers, exports, configuration, documentation, fixtures, and tests
Preserves tests for behavior that remains
Does not add compatibility paths or tests that only prove the old interface is absent
Runs relevant validation and reports intentional breaking changes

evals.name: explicit_compatibility
evals.prompt: Rename parse_record to decode_record, but keep parse_record working for existing callers.
expect: Recognizes the explicit backward compatibility requirement
Does not remove the old interface under the direct-removal default

evals.name: repository_policy_conflict
evals.prompt: Use $perform-clean-refactors to remove parse_record. The repository policy requires backward compatibility for public functions. I have not decided how to handle that requirement.
expect: Identifies the conflict between removal and repository policy
Stops before adding a compatibility shim

evals.name: additive_feature
evals.prompt: Add a JSON export option. Keep all current export options.
expect: Does not select this skill for ordinary additive feature work
Does not remove existing export options
